description: What this project already concluded about a failure like this one: earlier failures that resemble it, what was decided, by which rule or which person, and the run each came from. Answers from records Tewip kept, never from a guess - and says plainly when nothing resembles it. Use before deciding what a failure means, and for questions like "have we seen this error before?".

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

question.description: An error message, or a question in plain words

test.description: Narrow to one test id, when the question is about a particular test

name: recall
title: Has this happened here before?
